reference: There are two people in the empty meadow.
sk: Na prázdnej lúke sú dvaja ľudia.
cz: Na prázdné louce jsou dva lidé.
acceptable: There are two people in the empty {meadow|field}.
In the empty {meadow|field} there are two people.

mistakes.text: There is two people in the empty meadow.
There are two peoples in the empty meadow.
There are two people on the empty meadow.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri lúke sa hovorí „in the meadow“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U louky se říká „in the meadow“.

mistakes.text: In the empty meadow are two people.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Precvičuje sa „there are“: „In the empty meadow there are…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se „there are“: „In the empty meadow there are…“.

mistakes.text: There are two persons in the empty meadow.
